title: Concept: Lockfile resolves a dependency from a local path
description: package-lock.json declares a lockfile entry resolved from a path on the build machine, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The tree is not reproducible from the lockfile alone, and the bytes that compile are whatever that path holds at build time.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: The tree is not reproducible from the lockfile alone, and the bytes that compile are whatever that path holds at build time.
